question: A company sells custom scooters and bikes for customers. The profit per scooter is $200 and the profit per bike is $300. Each product requires time with the design team and engineering team. Each scooter needs 2 hours with the design team and 3 hours with the engineering team. Each bike needs 4 hours with the design team and 5 hours with the engineering team. Per month, there are 5000 hours available on the design team and 6000 hours available on the engineering team. How many of each should the company make per month to maximize profit?

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "profit": {"scooter": 200, "bike": 300},
    "design_hours": {"scooter": 2, "bike": 4},
    "engineering_hours": {"scooter": 3, "bike": 5},
    "design_capacity": 5000,
    "engineering_capacity": 6000,
    "products": ["scooter", "bike"],
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # Objective: maximise 200*scooter + 300*bike
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["profit"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P)
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # Each scooter needs 2 hours with design team -> per-product design usage cap
    def scooter_design_rule(m):
        return d["design_hours"]["scooter"] * m.x["scooter"] <= d["design_capacity"]
    model.scooter_design = pyo.Constraint(rule=scooter_design_rule)

    # Each bike needs 4 hours with design team -> per-product design usage cap
    def bike_design_rule(m):
        return d["design_hours"]["bike"] * m.x["bike"] <= d["design_capacity"]
    model.bike_design = pyo.Constraint(rule=bike_design_rule)

    # Design team has 5000 hours available per month (shared capacity)
    def design_capacity_rule(m):
        return sum(d["design_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P) <= d["design_capacity"]
    model.design_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=design_capacity_rule)

    # Each scooter needs 3 hours with the engineering team
    def scooter_eng_rule(m):
        return d["engineering_hours"]["scooter"] * m.x["scooter"] <= d["engineering_capacity"]
    model.scooter_engineering = pyo.Constraint(rule=scooter_eng_rule)

    # Each bike needs 5 hours with the engineering team
    def bike_eng_rule(m):
        return d["engineering_hours"]["bike"] * m.x["bike"] <= d["engineering_capacity"]
    model.bike_engineering = pyo.Constraint(rule=bike_eng_rule)

    # Engineering team has 6000 hours available per month (shared capacity)
    def engineering_capacity_rule(m):
        return sum(d["engineering_hours"][p] * m.x[p] for p in m.P) <= d["engineering_capacity"]
    model.engineering_capacity = pyo.Constraint(rule=engineering_capacity_rule)

    return model
